newsitem.title: USA: U.S. mortgage application volume rose in latest wk.
newsitem.headline: U.S. mortgage application volume rose in latest wk.

text.p: The volume of U.S. mortgage applications rose 1.9 percent in the week ended June 27, according to a Mortgage Bankers Association of America weekly survey.
Specifically, the volume of applications to refinance mortgages rose 6.5 percent in the latest survey week, while applications to purchase mortgages inched up 0.5 percent.
The seasonally adjusted refinancing index rose 6.5 percent to 422.4 from 396.5 the previous week.
The purchase index rose 0.7 percent to 208.0 in the latest survey from 206.5 in the previous week
